FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(AMPANG-KUALA LUMPUR ELEVATED HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Ampang-Kuala Lumpur Elevated Highway) (Amendment)

Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 20 October 2022.

Amendment paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Ampang-Kuala Lumpur Elevated Highway) Order 2001 [P.U. (A) 166/2001], which is

referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)

by substituting for the words "15 May 2029" the words "15 May 2037".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLL

(1)

Classes of Vehicles

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

1. Vehicle having two axles and three or four wheels

(excluding taxis and buses)

2.13

2. Vehicle having two axles and five or six wheels

(excluding buses)

7.00

3. Vehicle having three axles or more (excluding

buses)

10.50

4. Taxis 1.53

5. Buses 1.28

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Made 19 October 2022

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/15; PN(PU2)426/LXIX]

DATO‘ SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Senior Minister of Works
